# Millbrook Orchard Group

This folder holds the paperwork of the Millbrook Orchard Group: the pressing-day dates, the volunteer roles and the leaflet we hand out at the orchard gate. Every volunteer who helps with the paperwork keeps their own copy of this shared repository.

## Rules

- Write dates as day, month name, year, for example 12 October 2026.
- Show prices in pounds with the pence, for example £3.50.
- The leaflet is public: it carries no volunteer phone numbers.
- Juice is sold by the litre bottle. Never write "gallon".
